members.blastoise:
profile: roboboat -> blastoise
network_env: <root>/blastoise/network.env
registry: <root>/blastoise/devices.yaml
hosts:
  driver: hosts/fleet
  repos:
    all:
    - mhseals_hardware
    - mhseals_nav
    - mhseals_testing
    boat_computer: []
    camera_host:
    - direct_lidar_inertial_odometry
    operator:
    - rviz-plugin-zed-od
    - zed-ros2-wrapper
    - mhseals_agents
    gateway: []
  sources:
    mhseals_hardware:
      url: https://github.com/MHSeals/mhseals_hardware.git
    mhseals_nav:
      url: https://github.com/MHSeals/mhseals_nav.git
    mhseals_testing:
      url: https://github.com/MHSeals/mhseals_testing.git
    mhseals_agents:
      url: https://github.com/MHSeals/mhseals_agents.git
    direct_lidar_inertial_odometry:
      url: https://github.com/vectr-ucla/direct_lidar_inertial_odometry.git
      branch: feature/ros2
    rviz-plugin-zed-od:
      url: https://github.com/mhseals/rviz-plugin-zed-od.git
    zed-ros2-wrapper:
      url: https://github.com/stereolabs/zed-ros2-wrapper.git
      branch: master
  compose_project: astro_dock_devcontainer
  operator_heartbeat: ros2 run mhseals_testing operator_heartbeat
  operator_key: mhseals/ssh
  operator_registry: mhseals/devices.yaml
jetson:
  driver: jetson/l4t
  family: jetson-jp6-jazzy
  image: lunarzdev/astro
  gateway: gateway
  validator: .devcontainer/boat-validate.sh
  workflow: promote-jetson.yml
lidar:
  driver: lidar/vlp16
  address: 192.168.0.201
  model: VLP16
  mac: 60:76:88:38:35:85
  rpm: 600
  netmask: 255.255.255.0
  gateway: 192.168.0.1
  data_host: 192.168.0.153
  data_port: 2368
  telemetry_port: 8308
  returns: Strongest
  fov:
    start: 0
    end: 359
  jump: LIDAR_JUMP
radio:
  driver: radio/airmax
  ssid: blastoise
  revert_seconds: 300
  devices:
    rocket:
      address: 192.168.0.22
      mac: ac:8b:a9:c8:aa:f9
      role: ap
      cfg: ''
    bullet:
      address: 192.168.0.21
      mac: ac:8b:a9:c8:ca:18
      role: station
      cfg: ''
  reachable:
  - 192.168.0.1
  - 192.168.0.152
  credentials:
    user: UBNT_USER
    password: UBNT_PASSWORD
    jump: UBNT_JUMP
  measure:
    target: 192.168.0.152
    container: roboboat_dev
    seconds: 10
    port: 5201
    credentials:
      user: BOAT_HOST_USER
      password: BOAT_HOST_PASSWORD
  propose:
    range_m: 1000
    freq: ''
    width_max: 40
    txpower_max: ''
router:
  driver: router/ddwrt
  name: mhseals
  time_zone: America/Chicago
  lan:
    address: 192.168.0.1
    netmask: 255.255.255.0
    gateway: 192.168.0.2
  dns:
  - 1.1.1.1
  - 8.8.8.8
  dhcp:
    start: '100'
    count: '50'
    lease_minutes: 1440
    reservations: 56:e2:03:5c:60:22=blastoise-odroid=192.168.0.152 3c:6d:66:bf:6b:e2=blastoise-jetson=192.168.0.153
  revert_seconds: 300
  credentials:
    user: ROUTER_USER
    password: ROUTER_PASSWORD
    admin_password: ROUTER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
    wifi_password: BOAT_WIFI_PASSWORD
